name: Mumla
tagline: Talk with your team using voice chat rooms
description:
Mumla is an app for Mumble, a voice chat system popular with gamers and online communities who want low-latency, high-quality group voice calls. Join a server, hop into a channel, and talk with your friends or teammates in real time.

It's a solid, no-nonsense way to bring Mumble voice chat to your Android phone.
